title: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
description: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.
text:
Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights.

And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process. Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., is threatening to hold Dr.

Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment rights and did not answer any questions about the coronavirus pandemic during a Senate committee hearing yesterday. Fauci played a key role as the nation's top infectious disease expert throughout the COVID-19 pandemic.
